original_bug_description: Heap-use-after-free in the Zend VM: ZEND_FE_FETCH_RW_SPEC_VAR_HANDLER (Zend/zend_vm_execute.h) performs a read from heap memory that has already been freed. The freed region is released via zend_array_destroy (zend_hash.c) during ArrayIterator setup (ext/spl/spl_array.c, zim_ArrayIterator___construct / spl_array_set_array), but later VM bytecode handlers still access the deallocated memory. This use-after-free can cause crashes, memory corruption and may lead to further exploitation such as arbitrary code execution.
